_note: Achievements, in the order the achievements screen lists them. 'badge' is the short text on the badge until real art exists. 'hidden' ones show as ??? until earned. An entry with 'stat' and 'goal' unlocks once that lifetime counter reaches the goal and shows a progress bar; the rest are checked in scripts/rules/achievement_rules.gd by id.
